# NookNook

> NookNook is a free, 100% offline note-taking desk for Windows 10 and 11. Rich markdown notes, tasks with reminders, a kanban board, an offline meeting recorder, 24 themes and optional AI chat with your own API key. The installer is about 2 MB, there are no accounts and nothing leaves the PC.

Core facts:
- Platform: Windows 10 / Windows 11 (native app, Tauri 2 + Rust core)
- Storage: local SQLite database in the user's own folder; no cloud, no telemetry
- Size: ~2 MB installer; light on memory
- License: MIT, open source
- Price: free
- Developer: MrRealORG (Mr Real)
- Latest version: v0.20.0 (see changelog for the full release history)

Key features:
- Markdown notes with live preview, copy-as-markdown, ==highlight== and quick tools
- Tasks with reminders, repeats and due dates
- Kanban board with labels, checklists and live stats
- Offline meeting recorder that saves .wav files on the PC
- Insights view with streaks and a 14-day activity chart
- Command palette (Ctrl+K), Zen mode, note templates, HTML export
- 24 themes with accent colors
- AI chat (optional) using the user's own API key
